decision_source: Owner B3 Final Closure instruction (issue #127 / Draft PR #131)
accepted_risks: The Mihomo controller credential is write-capable even when the agent only performs GET.
A GET-only client is not a server-side read-only authorization.
The credential must not be shared with a production application or rotated by the agent.
required_controls: no arbitrary URL/path/method or generic RPC
no redirects, proxy environment or DNS indirection
bounded response, timeout and resource controls
DPAPI CurrentUser sealed controller secret with private DACL
no secret in logs, CLI arguments, environment values, center config or telemetry
independent selection and active_connections sampling with six frozen tokens
no changes to Mihomo/Clash Verge Rev/HA configuration, selection, or connections
forbidden: production enablement without separate Owner authorization
new write-capable bridge process without a new trust-boundary decision
